ONE_LINER: Instant cross-border payroll for remote teams
PROBLEM: Companies with distributed teams waste 3-5 days and 4-8% in fees on international payroll. Existing solutions are slow, opaque, and built for enterprises — not startups and SMBs.
SOLUTION: PayFlow uses local payment rails and real-time FX to deliver same-day payroll in 60+ countries. One API, flat 1% fee, full compliance handled.
TRACTION: Live in 12 countries. 140 paying companies. $2.8M ARR, growing 22% MoM. NRR: 135%. Average contract: $1,700/mo.
TEAM: CEO: ex-Wise, built their SMB product (0→$50M ARR). CTO: ex-Stripe, led Stripe Connect payments infra. Head of Compliance: 10yr at HSBC global payments.
